decisions.pe: A young woman from Russia went to Cyprus on a special visa for cabaret work and died soon after. Her father took the case to the European Court. It said both countries failed her: trafficking is covered by the ban on slavery and forced labour, and states must prevent it, protect victims and investigate.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan muda dari Rusia pergi ke Siprus dengan visa khusus untuk bekerja di kabaret dan meninggal tak lama kemudian. Ayahnya membawa perkara ke Pengadilan HAM Eropa. Pengadilan menyatakan kedua negara gagal: perdagangan orang termasuk larangan perbudakan dan kerja paksa, dan negara wajib mencegah,…

help.de: Free information, support and mediation for migrants, including domestic workers and victims of trafficking.
help.di: Informasi, dukungan dan mediasi gratis bagi migran, termasuk pekerja rumah tangga dan korban perdagangan orang.
